styles.name: Woodcut
styles.description: Bold carved-wood print language with broad dark masses, directional gouges and restrained wood-grain interruptions.

instructions.materials: Suggest dense relief-print ink with carved light channels passing through dark body regions.
instructions.forms: Reduce the mascot to strong interlocking forms with broad cheeks, limbs and simple facial features.
instructions.linework: Use angular cut contours and a few thick directional gouges to define anatomy.
instructions.shading: Shade through grouped carved hatch channels of varying width instead of smooth gradients.
instructions.palette: Use a small set of ink colors with strong light-dark separation and required identity accents.
instructions.texture: Add restrained wood-grain interruptions inside large ink masses, aligned with an approved grain direction.
instructions.rendering: Render an isolated woodcut-style character on alpha, keeping the light body substrate inside the silhouette.

negative_constraints: Avoid a wooden block, printed paper rectangle or detached carving chips.
Do not use dense fine gouges that make the character look hairy or fragmented.
limitations: Carved light marks must not sever narrow limbs or erase approved markings at compact scale.

compatibility.scaling: Render with sufficient source detail, then downsample once with the recommended filter into the existing profile cells; inspect the final silhouette at actual size.
notes: Distinguish intentional light carving marks inside opaque body regions from alpha outside the printed silhouette.
Keep texture and shading inside the isolated silhouette; preserve the same approved pattern placement across animation states.

styles.name: Linocut
styles.description: Graphic relief-print character with smooth sweeping carved contours, solid ink masses and rounded negative cuts.

instructions.materials: Use dense matte print ink with clean carved light shapes and subtle interior roller coverage.
instructions.forms: Build the body from broad simplified masses with smooth curved silhouettes and clear joint gaps.
instructions.linework: Draw sweeping cut contours and rounded gouge marks rather than fine pen-like outlines.
instructions.shading: Describe volume using a few broad curved light cuts through solid ink areas.
instructions.palette: Choose two or three coordinated ink families while preserving mandatory identity colors.
instructions.texture: Add slight uneven ink coverage inside broad solids without visible wood-grain lines.
instructions.rendering: Render an isolated linocut character with decisive positive-negative shape balance and clean outer edges.

negative_constraints: Avoid wood grain, etched hairlines or a printed paper backing.
Do not let carved negative channels split the face or detach small body parts.
limitations: Wide carved cuts require careful placement to preserve small facial landmarks.

compatibility.scaling: Render with sufficient source detail, then downsample once with the recommended filter into the existing profile cells; inspect the final silhouette at actual size.
notes: Use alpha outside the print and keep any light body fill intact; chroma cleanup must not widen carved channels.
Keep texture and shading inside the isolated silhouette; preserve the same approved pattern placement across animation states.

styles.name: Screen Print
styles.description: Layered spot-ink character with opaque overlapping color shapes, restrained mesh texture and precise registered silhouettes.

instructions.materials: Use flat opaque screen-print inks with a dry matte surface.
instructions.forms: Organize the body into large separable color shapes and simple registered facial landmarks.
instructions.linework: Define forms through clean stencil-like ink boundaries, adding only necessary contour strokes.
instructions.shading: Build shade from a small number of overlapping spot-color shapes rather than continuous gradients.
instructions.palette: Plan a concise set of compatible ink colors whose overlap mixtures remain stable.
instructions.texture: Suggest faint mesh or ink deposit texture only inside broad filled areas.
instructions.rendering: Render an isolated registered print character with no off-body registration marks or paper surround.

negative_constraints: Avoid color misregistration extending outside the approved silhouette.
Do not add crop marks, printer labels or a paper poster background.
limitations: Very subtle ink textures may vanish after reduction; the design must work as flat shapes first.

compatibility.scaling: Render with sufficient source detail, then downsample once with the recommended filter into the existing profile cells; inspect the final silhouette at actual size.
notes: Keep intentional overprint mixtures inside body regions and ensure none collide with a selected chroma key.

instructions.linework: Keep the outer silhouette clean while allowing tiny internal offsets between selected color layers.
instructions.shading: Use overprinted tone patches and sparse coarse dot fields to suggest form.
instructions.palette: Choose a few approved ink families with deliberate mixed colors where layers overlap.

instructions.linework: Use sharply tapered contours and disciplined parallel form lines with clean intersections.
instructions.shading: Vary hatch spacing and line thickness to create light-dark modeling around each major volume.
instructions.palette: Favor dark ink against a clear light value, preserving explicit color identifiers as approved accents.
instructions.texture: Keep the line pattern regular and anatomy-following with no random grain.

instructions.forms: Reduce the figure to rounded simple forms with large clear facial landmarks.
instructions.linework: Define the boundary with a denser dotted band or sparse solid contour where readability needs it.
instructions.shading: Build volume by changing dot density in broad patches, keeping dot size mostly consistent.
instructions.palette: Use a concise ink and light-value scheme with essential identity accents retained explicitly.
instructions.texture: Place irregular but controlled hand-stipple dot spacing anchored to the same body regions.
instructions.rendering: Render an isolated stippled mascot with no points drifting outside the approved silhouette.

negative_constraints: Avoid detached dot clouds, random speckle halos or transparent dust around the body.
Do not describe tiny eyes solely through faint sparse dots.
limitations: Dot patterns can shimmer during motion unless their placement and density remain tied to the character form.
